contract.functional_unit: One complete sale pack for a nominated portion; cross-format comparisons are screening only until equal fill/fit is verified.
contract.observed_definition: Source observation for its stated scope, not a compliance approval. Manufacturer family claims stay family-scoped.
contract.inherited_rule: Unrecovered R3 exact-source values remain numerically preserved with ASSUMED/inherited boundary, never fresh OBSERVED_VERIFIED.
contract.unknown_rule: null is not zero; missing evidence blocks qualification and is excluded from numerical ranking.

assumptions.value: Cook -> transfer hot food -> retail pack -> hot hold up to six hours -> purchase

workflow_temperature.qualifier: Provider actual hot-fill and cabinet setpoints absent. Six hours is a requirement, not demonstrated safety.

literal_oven_fallback.qualifier: Separate branch; unknown duration must be supplied before qualification.

cost_premium_target.qualifier: Working commercial tolerance, not a quote.

contract.gate_policy: Non-compensatory: PASS only with exact selected-use evidence; UNKNOWN/QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED cannot be offset by sustainability metrics.
contract.ranking_policy: Compare qualified survivors by virgin plastic, mass, cost, procurement and EOL; no weighted eco score. Current qualified survivor set is empty.
contract.annualization: Disabled: annual pack count unknown; never infer Profi consumption from MOQ.
contract.simulation: No Monte Carlo. Bounded deterministic corners; intervals are conditional scenario envelopes, not confidence intervals.

sources.limitations: Historical family document; not six-hour fatty-food finished-system qualification.

sources.title: Intergastra 2026 product news
sources.findings: Current English news claims up to 185 C; retain alongside historical 175 C. Does not identify a revised SI-14 dossier.
sources.limitations: Wider 215 C statements elsewhere concern other scopes and do not supersede SI-14 evidence.
sources.geographical_relevance: International technical/commercial analogue; transfer limited to stated scope

sources.findings: Published six hours at 90 C and five hours at 100 C family claims. Co-developed film mentioned; precise nominated film code absent.
sources.limitations: Cannot transfer to commercial NVS45 or claim six-hour food safety at Profi.
sources.geographical_relevance: International technical/commercial analogue; transfer limited to stated scope

sources.title: BIOPAP distributor flyer
sources.findings: SI-14 article 65307: 780/carton and 12480/pallet; transparent biofilm 215 mm article 66761 listed.
sources.limitations: Historical selling configuration, no Romanian stock/lead-time commitment; film not identified as NVS45.
sources.geographical_relevance: International technical/commercial analogue; transfer limited to stated scope

sources.title: SI-14 780 trays
sources.findings: 251.79 EUR per 780; confirmed by direct HTTP page read after web tool error. VAT basis not found. Central conservatively treats amount as net; low branch discounts 25% to bracket VAT/quantity ambiguity.
sources.limitations: Body only, no film/freight; not a confirmed RO quote.
sources.geographical_relevance: International technical/commercial analogue; transfer limited to stated scope

sources.title: BIOF22248 NatureFlex roll
sources.scope: Belgian film price and mass analogue
sources.findings: Direct HTTP page: 185 mm x 500 m, 45 micrometre; 177.42 EUR single roll, 172.10 at 5, 166.78 at 10; explicitly not oven resistant.
sources.limitations: 185 mm width cannot cover 190 mm SI-14 outside rim. Transfer EUR/m2 only, to a designed >=210 mm hot-hold film; supplier compatibility and VAT must be confirmed.
sources.geographical_relevance: International technical/commercial analogue; transfer limited to stated scope

sources.title: Oven Ease HC2X40/HC2X70 sell sheet
sources.findings: Page 1 explicitly lists 2, 2.5, 3 mil gauges: 50.8, 63.5, 76.2 micrometre. Used solely for C3 gauge model.
sources.limitations: US 190/204 C and 4-hour statements are not current EMEA C3 thermal evidence; parsed page-2 table is misaligned.
sources.geographical_relevance: International technical/commercial analogue; transfer limited to stated scope

sources.title: Merchandiser product losing temperature
sources.findings: Chicken should enter merchandiser at 82-88 C (180-190 F). Anchors 85 C fill central separately from cabinet stress condition.
sources.limitations: Not Profi process; not six-hour safety/quality validation.
sources.geographical_relevance: International technical/commercial analogue; transfer limited to stated scope

sources.title: Cooking-premises inspection sheet
sources.findings: Section 2.14 cites minimum 60 C for hot dishes, including rotisserie chicken, before service (Order 976/1998 art.37). Search index read; direct web open failed. Corroborating official legislative portal indexed text matches.
sources.limitations: Not a six-hour permission or 90 C cabinet prescription; final applicability and HACCP release require operator QA.
sources.geographical_relevance: Romania

sources.title: T559 cm-22 grease resistance method scope
sources.findings: Kit test is primarily a surface repellency test; applicability to film barriers/nonfluorochemical treatments must be evaluated.
sources.limitations: Do not fabricate kit rating or substitute kit test for six-hour seam leakage.
sources.geographical_relevance: International technical/commercial analogue; transfer limited to stated scope

sources.title: Romania waste profile 2025
sources.findings: Separate collection and treatment gaps constrain actual recovery. Use conditional local-operator routes, no national recovery percentage transferred to packs.
sources.limitations: Does not establish disposal outcome for any exact greasy package.
sources.geographical_relevance: Romania

sources.title: Food-contact framework Regulation 1935/2004
sources.findings: Article 3 requires appropriate safety/inertness under normal or foreseeable use; traceability is required. Engineering mass calculations do not establish compliance.
sources.limitations: Material-specific measures and current amendments must be checked by responsible supplier/lab for actual commercial use.

end_of_life.romania_route: Romania has no at-scale separate collection/processing route for certified compostable food packaging: biowaste separate collection only became mandatory in 2024, the resulting compost lacks a legal definition, and most biowaste is still collected mixed and landfilled (SRC-037, SRC-038). Realistic current route for a grease-soiled LC tray: residual waste, with organic-bin disposal only where a functioning biowaste collection exists. Certificate != infrastructure (contract section 3 C5).

qualification_release_checklist: Provider: weigh empty complete B1 packs, identify polymer/size/gauge/SKU, supply same-VAT-basis invoice and annual units.
Provider: confirm post-cook versus package-in-oven, actual hot-fill temperature, cabinet profile/duration and product fill geometry.
Supplier: nominate exact body, viewing component, closure and ancillary BOM, current masses/PCR/renewable shares and source documents.
Supplier: exact selected-use DoC/migration and safety-relevant substance statements; no calculated legal or food-safety pass.
Physical test: fit, sealing, fatty-food leakage, steam/anti-fog, handling and six-hour organoleptic/microbiological validation by the responsible team.
Procurement: exact paired SKU stock, delivery to Romanian site, current VAT/freight quote, MOQ and lead time.
Waste operator: collection, sorting and reprocessing/composting acceptance for the actual greasy tray/bag/lid combination.

pitch_safe_claims.claim: Prioritised physical concepts for four hot-food use cases
pitch_safe_claims.evidence: 48 product/candidate/workflow gate records; no fully qualified survivor
pitch_safe_claims.wording: For whole chicken we prioritise Gaia qualification; for portions, BIOPAP LC SI-14. A locally listed aluminium option provides a practical sample path. All require exact-use qualification.
Our current PET/PA-like bag scenario gives about 2.6-12.5 g, central 6.5 g. We have not weighed the Profi pack.
The SI-14 tray has a historical manufacturer nominal mass of 23.5 g. With a modelled clear film and allowance, the pack is approximately 23.4-30.2 g, central 26.6 g.

If the LC tray is plastic-free and we conservatively count the entire clear film as virgin plastic, the model gives about 53% central reduction against an estimated bag. Its range runs from 68% more to 82% less, so no reduction is verified.
The listed Romanian portion tray and transparent lid cost about 1.15-1.29 RON including VAT per pair under our order scenario; fit and hot-hold suitability still need testing.
BIOPAP publishes a six-hour, 90 C claim for its LC family. The exact tray-film-food combination and food safety have not been validated for Profi.
